## How this was produced

1. `uas-oscal component` built the [component definition](../../oscal/generated/component-definition.json) from the P1 requirements and threat trace and the control mapping in `mappings/controls.yaml`.
2. `uas-oscal results` built the [assessment results](../../oscal/generated/ve07-assessment-results.json) from the VE-07 CI evidence summary (`summary.json`) vendored from the P2 verified-boot repository. A finding is satisfied only when the run passed and every test case passed.
3. `uas-oscal render` produced this page from those two OSCAL files.

CI reruns all three commands, fails if the committed files differ from the rebuilt ones, and validates the OSCAL with NIST oscal-cli.
